page_title: UNI 2-2 MAI | Union Berlin v Mainz 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
86' 2 - 2 Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) rises high to meet a superb cross from the free kick. His header goes behind the helpless goalkeeper and ricochets in off the crossbar.
86' It seemed like Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Phillip Tietz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
79' Unbelievable miss! Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

79' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was all set to celebrate a sensational goal after he collected a rebound and blasted a shot in from long range. Unfortunately for him, his effort crashed against the crossbar. What an unlucky moment for him.
78' That will be all from Benedict Hollerbach who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
78' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. Paul Nebel (Mainz) replaces Nadiem Amiri.
78' A substitution has been made. Diogo Leite goes off and Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) comes on.

77' 1 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Derrick Kohn finds Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Daniel Batz had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
76' Some great controlled play and passing from Mainz. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
74' The attendance is 22012.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Burke departs the field of play to be replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
70' Substitution. Janik Haberer walks off the pitch and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
69' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Nikolas Veratschnig sprays a pass out to Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:2.
65' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Livan Burcu is replaced by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) for Aljoscha Kemlein.
64' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
57' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.
56' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
55' Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' The possession of the ball – 55:45.
50' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Phillip Tietz (Mainz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
47' The game is interrupted. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

43' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
42' Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
39' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
38' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
35' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
32' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
30' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jae-Sung Lee tees up Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Frederik Ronnow.
28' Frederik Ronnow pulls off a great save to deny Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
25' Great save! Phillip Tietz (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Frederik Ronnow.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
21' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
19' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.

17' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
14' Mainz keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
12' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

11' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
9' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
5' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

3' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
